title: Lower bound for hitting probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $s,t$ be vertices such that there is a finite adjacency path from $s$ to $t$. For every natural number $L$, the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $L$ neighbor indices visits $t$, including at the starting vertex, is at least $1-2D|V|^3/(L+1)$, where $|V|$ is the number of vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The multigraph has a finite vertex set V
There is a finite adjacency path from s to t
